reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: sync path (checkColumnResponse at request_manager.nim:190) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, which validates Merkle proof but not kzg_commitments length. Gossip path (gossip_validation.nim:596) calls verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim:359), which rejects empty kzg_commitments. Spec requirement from 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json PROP-6a4369e9-inv-011 explicitly mandates non-empty kzg_commitments. Exploitability uncertain: attacker can only provide empty kzg_commitments if block itself has zero blob_kzg_commitments (Merkle proof enforces this), and such blocks are rare post-Fulu. No demonstrated path to actual harm (crashes, state corruption). Severity downgraded from Medium to Low due to limited practical exploitability and inclusion proof protection preventing arbitrary data injection.
